counter_definitions.TCC_REQ_sum: requests processed by the TCC/L2 tag blocks
counter_definitions.TCP_TCC_READ_REQ_sum: read requests sent from TCP/L1 to TCC/L2
counter_definitions.TCP_TCC_WRITE_REQ_sum: write requests sent from TCP/L1 to TCC/L2
counter_definitions.TCP_TOTAL_CACHE_ACCESSES_sum: TCP/L1 cache-line tag accesses, including hits and misses

measurement_scope.aggregation: median dispatch within each profiler launch, then median across independent profiler launches
measurement_scope.hardware: whole-kernel counters; all non-target inputs and output traffic are fixed between each default/selected pair
measurement_scope.quotient: the issue component models transaction_bytes regions for the persistent target operand only
measurement_scope.thrashed: a cache-thrash dispatch precedes every target dispatch and is excluded by the rocprof kernel filter
